definitions.explanation: Acts of kindness and generosity toward those in need, especially organized charitable activities. Often used as a modifier before other nouns to describe charitable events or organizations.

examples.japanese: {慈善|じぜん}{団体|だんたい}に{寄付|きふ}した。
examples.english: I donated to a charity organization.

examples.japanese: {慈善|じぜん}{活動|かつどう}に{参加|さんか}するボランティアを{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
examples.english: They are recruiting volunteers to participate in charitable activities.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{歌手|かしゅ}が{慈善|じぜん}コンサートを{開|ひら}き、{収益|しゅうえき}をすべて{被災地|ひさいち}に{寄付|きふ}した。
examples.english: A famous singer held a charity concert and donated all the proceeds to the disaster-affected area.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears as a modifier before nouns: {慈善|じぜん}{団体|だんたい}, {慈善|じぜん}{事業|じぎょう}, {慈善|じぜん}{活動|かつどう}. A somewhat formal word; in casual speech, チャリティー (charity) is increasingly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慈善|じぜん}{団体|だんたい} (charitable organization)
- {慈善|じぜん}{事業|じぎょう} (charitable work, philanthropy)
- {慈善|じぜん}{活動|かつどう} (charitable activities)
- {慈善|じぜん}コンサート / チャリティーコンサート (charity concert)

DO NOT CONFUSE:
- {事前|じぜん}: beforehand, in advance — same reading, different kanji and meaning
